title: Symbols aboard the craft and the gray alliance of seven species
summary: Steve Coburn tells of Symbols aboard the craft and the gray alliance of seven species, about unspecified at craft over Fillmore, California, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And um I'm led to believe that um the three um orange circles arranged in an equilateral triangle is the symbol of the gray alliance.

plain: A man named Steve Coburn says he was aboard a craft over Fillmore, California, and saw symbols there. He says he has been led to believe that three orange circles arranged in a triangle are the symbol of a "gray alliance," a union of seven non-human species that includes the grays, the large-eyed beings often described in such accounts. He told this on a podcast with a host, Jesse Michels.
